validation: same case; label date strictly before production cutoff; training strictly before test date; exclude entire held-out parent and cold-start target parent
review_scope: production union: one earliest-start-to-cutoff horizon per target section, pooled without segment or overlapping-window replication
observation_weighting: one per valid contributing timestamp; p95 numpy linear quantile; separate duration-weighted mean
historical_scope: only target-specific eligible training windows; no target-date or later labels
decision_rule: retain all five for testing; no winner or narrowed grid without independent validation
legacy_role: compatibility control only; excluded from candidate grid and selection
